growth_signal.value: Raised a $35M Series A led by Sequoia Capital in December 2025 and named to the VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026.

entry.idea: Wealth managers spend much of their time on paperwork, so Nevis builds AI software that does that work for them.
entry.lesson: Pick a high-paid profession full of routine paperwork and build AI that does the paperwork.
